Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — v2.dramafren.org/popular/ hijacks the first click with an invisible #⁠safePopupArea overlay and opens an ad pop-up tab (otieu.com); the dd133.com ad tag is already blocked, so the fix is v2.dramafren.org#⁠%#⁠//scriptlet('prevent-window-open'). The experiment recorded pop-ups in phases A and B but none with the candidate (1/1/0) with page integrity intact, yet the vision review stayed inconclusive because an invisible overlay and a pop-up tab cannot be seen in static screenshots, so the rule goes to human review unverified.

## Candidate for review

`v2.dramafren.org#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

Not verified: apply_rule environmentExperiment was inconclusive:⁠ the visual review returned verdict inconclusive, symptom 'unclear', pageIntegrity 'intact', adLayoutResidue 'absent', remainingInstances empty and observedDamage empty, with no failedCandidateChecks. The reported defect is behavioral — an invisible full-page #⁠safePopupArea overlay captures the first click and opens an ad tab to otieu.com — so static phase screenshots cannot show it (completed full-page vision of the proxied session reports reporterSymptomPresence 'absent' for the same reason). The experiment's revealSteps nevertheless recorded popupsOpened 1 (phase A), 1 (phase B baseline) and 0 (phase C with the candidate), so the candidate stopped the ad pop-up without touching page content; it needs a human to accept that behavioral proof.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44655277306
